messages.subject: comparing distance results
parts:
Dear All,
I have analysed results of a census of Colobus monkeys using Distance
(cheers Len).I would like to compare the results I have for 3 line
transects. Each transect was sampled repaetedly over a period of two weeks.
However the "effort" is different for one: 34.5,compared with 33 and 33. The
number of observations vary: 63,48,54. When I analyse them separately
Distance selects the uniform/cosine model for two and the halfnormal/hermite
for one. I would like to be able to compare the densities of the three to
see if there is a significant difference and to relate any difference to
vegetation type. Is there a simple way to compare the three results?
If you are able to offer any suggestions please reply to:
darr...@hotmail.com
Many thanks,
Darren Norris
